Biosensor Group
The Biosensor Group builds implantable glucose sensors for continuous monitoring. In collaboration with Prof. Xaver Fremd from ETH Zurich we test new enzyme coatings for long term stability. Prof. Dr. Lena Probe is the group head of the Biosensor Group since 2021 and teaches sensor physics.
